items.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Cat Anderson saved my life... one night I said, “Cat, what note do I play on the end of this tune.” He says, “Grab a note that sounds wrong and hold on.”

ctx.x: But it’s not weird actually you know because okay now well my section was cool you know I mean like friends-wise you know. But in the [inaudible] section if he asked anybody anything about where to come in at, he won’t tell them nothing.
Well that is really not true. I mean I’ve heard those stories all the time, but no, Cat Anderson saved my life.
